verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a web-reading and scraping API, and such services could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring background jobs, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents one-off, per-request actions: URL conversion, search that fetches the top results, caching, and the MCP server. It shows no way to set up recurring schedules, triggers, or autonomous background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
